limitations: Sizes N <= 8-9 only; a sparse infinite spectrum cannot be recognised from so few sizes. Question 3 of the cycle remains open.
statement: Among the 198 non-rigid laws of EXP-C13-02, 190 have anchored models at every N = 6, 7, 8 (the others have UNKNOWN instances or small exceptions); no law other than left-distributivity was found whose non-affine models occur only at sparse sizes such as powers of two.
title: Non-affine models typically exist for all sizes beyond a small threshold; no Laver-like sparse spectrum found
